title: Anatomy of a Humanoid
authorship: Original Mechanism Studio composition and code synthesis, with separately licensed CC0 effects by Kenney. No narration or recorded robot acoustics.
musicalFeel: Mellow sustained chords, warm half-time bass and sparse felt keys. Quiet reading views and a soft return. No drums or constant dings.
timing: One seekable PCM transport; seconds = beat * 60 / 108. Every group cue binds source IDs and the same authored movement window.

mix.sampleGainReference: The music peak before sample mixing. CC0 source amplitudes are attenuated by gainDb against that reference; no per-sample normalization.
mix.effects: Sparse editorial cues, not simulated contact, actuator sounds or hardware recordings.

effects.clock: Baked into the same PCM buffer. No wall-clock timers or chapter restarts.
effects.readingCuePolicy: One quiet first-name cue per detail scene; later retained names remain silent.

analysis.listeningReview: Objective waveform checks only; subjective listening and the encoded video mix require a separate review.
